svg.text: Parallel background execution plane coupled with a serialized priority-flush TurnQueue and persistent OMP RPC session
TIER 2: SERIALIZED OMP TURN QUEUE PLANE
Background tasks with timeouts & env inject
Rule 1 (Abort & Purge): Drop ALL pending items, abort immediately
Rule 2 (Steer): Dequeue FIFO steer (mid-turn interrupt prompt)
Rule 3 (Followup): Dequeue FIFO followup (appends to turn context)
Rule 4 (Prompt): Dequeue FIFO prompt ONLY when session is idle
Thread-safe async queue · History buffer (last 100 turns)
Awaits session readiness, handles abort signals & lifecycle
Cron job schemas, execution telemetry & session UUIDs
prompt, steer, followup, abort, abort_retry, get_state
Streams raw LLM chunks and tool calls live
Focal Core State Machine & Session Manager
